system_summary: A task-relative situated agent preserves an adequate relation between observations, current goals, delegated scope, resource-bounded decisions, real action and established effects. Architecture, learning, reflection and human interaction are guarded alternatives, not a mandatory serial pipeline. The integrated account is an analytical synthesis, not an empirically validated new academic school.
relation_direction: FROM REQUIRES TO means the FROM property depends on TO under the guard. Other types read FROM acts on/enables/constrains/provides evidence for TO. Negative and duplicate nodes record interpretative constraints, not active runtime components.

nodes.NAME: Situated task and authority context
nodes.ROLE: Criteria and inputs constrain what action can mean; they do not themselves execute anything.

nodes.NAME: Observation and state estimation
nodes.ROLE: Maintains distinctions needed for action and can select information gathering or non-action.

nodes.NAME: Practical reasoning and commitment
nodes.ROLE: Retains, revises or releases pursuit within its legitimate scope.

nodes.NAME: Conditional architecture choice
nodes.ROLE: Alternatives, not all mandatory modules. A designer’s choice need not be a runtime adaptive controller.

nodes.NAME: Monitored consequential execution
nodes.ROLE: Changes real objects or relationships through available tools or physical actions, observing what actually occurred.

nodes.NAME: Resource-sensitive decision scheduling
ACTORS: scheduler or simple fixed budget rule
nodes.ROLE: Constrains deliberation, action, retries and assistance; exact metareasoning is optional.

nodes.NAME: Bounded persistent learning and memory
nodes.ROLE: Optional persistence with explicit change and evaluation boundaries; open-ended assurance is unresolved.

nodes.NAME: Communication and human interaction
nodes.ROLE: Exchanges information, negotiates task meaning and changes actual control only when the operational handoff occurs.

nodes.NAME: Evaluation and scoped assurance
nodes.ROLE: Separately assesses outcome, repeated dependability and transfer; it does not authorise use merely by scoring it.

nodes.NAME: Contemporary language-model branch
nodes.ROLE: Optional implementation translation, constrained by the same task/effect duties plus input-integrity and version-change limits.

nodes.NAME: Failure-attributed feedback and revision
nodes.ROLE: Analytical construct: separates observation, action, goal, oracle and model failures so repair need not change the wrong mechanism.

nodes.NAME: Rejected inference and duplicate register
nodes.ROLE: These are constraints on interpretation and denominator preservation, not mandatory runtime components.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Autonomy claims need comparison.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: A declared task and boundary.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: One-dimensional ranking versus task-relative powers.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Autonomy dimensions qualify the boundary without replacing plural definitions.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Descriptive overhead or false numerical precision.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Mental-state or architecture claims are made.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: A distinction between explanatory vocabulary and implementation.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Prompt labels or logical predicates treated as executable conformance.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Demand state/transition/consumer evidence for claimed BDI semantics; language-model feedback alone is not proof.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Specification cost and possible over-formalisation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Capabilities or repair affect delegated tasks.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Capability and permission can be separately described.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Available tool or high affordance score taken as unlimited authority.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use delegated scope in selecting and dispatching actions, including generated repairs.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Blocking useful but unauthorised action; scope interpretation cost.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A stateful or belief-based architecture is selected.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Observations can update a task-relevant estimate.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Normalisation/internal consistency taken as world truth.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Keep latent state, observation and estimate distinct in updating the model.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Model and provenance maintenance.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Material conditions can change before dispatch.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Decision dependencies can be identified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Old observations assumed valid indefinitely.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Invalidate or refresh the decision basis before executing under changed state.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Additional sensing and race windows.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A query is proposed to resolve uncertainty.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: A possible answer could change the chosen action or confidence boundary.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Information gathering valuable regardless of decision.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Evaluate information against goal-relevant distinctions in the current estimate.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Query latency and attention cost.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Uncertainty can be resolved by sensing or asking.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Queries and questions are candidate actions with cost.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Human time or tool access treated as free.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Metareasoning selects whether to acquire information, act or defer.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Metalevel estimation may cost more than it saves.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Continuation lacks adequate grounds or authority.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: At least one feasible non-action, holding or assistance choice exists.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Generic no-op assumed safe in every environment.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Choose abstention, repair, handoff or stop according to consequence and feasibility.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Delay or unsafe waiting.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A condition must persist rather than merely be achieved once.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Task horizon and maintenance predicate are meaningful.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Restoration equated with ending the obligation.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Keep the goal active after temporary restoration and select predictive or reactive upkeep.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Monitoring and false preventive action.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Parallel intentions or layers can interfere.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Material conditions/effects/resources are summarised adequately.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Individually feasible actions assumed mutually compatible.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Protect shared conditions through applicable conflict checks or cheaper isolation/serialisation.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Conservative blocking and summary maintenance.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A persistent intention is retained.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Relevance, progress and feasibility can be assessed adequately.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Commitment equated with never reconsidering or abandoning.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Reconsider and terminate under the adopted commitment strategy, with budget-sensitive checks.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Thrashing or obsolete pursuit from bad triggers.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Further planning competes with timely execution.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Reconsideration has measurable or estimable cost.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A fixed universal reflection frequency is optimal.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Schedule commitment review as a bounded computation decision.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Poor value estimates and missed action windows.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A material delegated goal is abandoned or suspended.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: There is a legitimate recipient who needs to know non-fulfilment.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Silence or a sent message treated as accepted handback.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Report grounds and unresolved effects; distinguish notice from actual control transfer.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Attention burden and unresponsive recipient.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Direct observations permit an adequate policy.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The task and resource comparison are shared.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: More planning automatically means better architecture.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Select reaction instead of deliberation/library machinery where it meets the goal.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Limited foresight or omitted hidden state.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A structured multi-step task needs anticipation.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Goal and effect semantics are adequate.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Generative search and library interpretation assumed identical.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Choose model-based search or applicable plan-library control according to variation, coverage and cost.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Library gaps versus search/model expense.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Multiple decision time-scales have demonstrated value.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Interfaces reconcile state, priorities and execution meaning.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Independently adequate modules assumed jointly adequate.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Combine selected branches with explicit sequencing/arbitration and feedback, not a compulsory ladder.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Coordination cost, races and timing mismatch.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An architecture or new module is selected.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Comparable tasks, constraints and material resources.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Architecture richness itself counts as success.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Retain only the additional freedom or machinery that earns its cost against an adequate baseline.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Underengineering rare cases or overfitting a benchmark.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Plans select executable skills or tools.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Action identities and applicability map to real interfaces.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Fluent descriptions treated as executable capabilities.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Ground plan actions in a known capability vocabulary and context-sensitive affordances.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Skill maintenance and false feasibility estimates.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Dispatch can cause a consequential effect.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Material scope and current conditions can be checked.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Plan-time approval or skill existence sufficient for all later action.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Check relevant permission, capability and state at the operative boundary.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: False blocking, stale checks and check-to-use races.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An action or task is claimed complete.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The observation/return contract covers the desired effect.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Issuance or acknowledgement treated as actual fulfilment.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Effect evidence supports task-instance success and feeds evaluation, while uncovered policy criteria remain separate.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Observation cost or false completion from an incomplete oracle.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Execution returns or an effect is observed.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The update reflects what the observation actually establishes.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Expected effect substituted for observed effect.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Update state/progress and select continuation, intention release or repair.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Misleading feedback can propagate into multiple components.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A failed or changed plan is repaired.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Alternatives are bounded, executable and within the task.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Repair automatically authorises goal changes or unlimited retries.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Re-enter condition/effect checks under remaining resources and preserve goal/scope.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Repeated side effects and prolonged failure.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An effect may be irreversible or already occur without acknowledgement.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Effect and interruption semantics are known sufficiently.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Retry/undo/stop always restores the pre-action state.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Restrict retries and interruption to what the actual action semantics justify; report irrecoverable effects.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Conservative delay and incomplete compensation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Actions and deliberation share finite resources.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Material costs and deadlines are included.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Reasoning, sensing, help or retries are free.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use the operative envelope to bound cognition and external action alike.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Metering and premature stopping.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A deadline permits incremental improvement but requires a usable response.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Intermediate answer/fallback is available and interruption is real.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Any algorithm labelled anytime is timely or safe to interrupt.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Improve while useful time remains and fall back to an adequate available action.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Lower-quality early decisions and scheduling overhead.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A change is described as learning or self-revision.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Persistence and behavioural effect of the change are identifiable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Ordinary state update, text memory and utility self-change treated as one mechanism.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Apply the appropriate evaluation and authority boundary for the actual change type.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Tracking burden and missed indirect behavioural effects.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Stored experience informs later decisions.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Memory has source and evidential status, not only relevance.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Self-generated narrative treated as verified experience.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Retrieve and revise from warranted observations or qualified interpretations.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Stale/private/false memory can still contaminate decisions.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A persistent memory store is justified.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Retention has a relevant consumer and resource/privacy constraints.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Unlimited memory is inherently beneficial.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Select and retire stored material according to purpose, validity and costs.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Loss of rare useful evidence or excessive retention.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A persistent learned component changes.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Old/new task conditions and acceptable continuity are defined.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: New task gain implies overall improvement.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Evaluate retained competence and changed behaviour against adequate oracles and transfer cases.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Regression testing and reduced plasticity.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Learning explores consequential actions.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Protected constraints are defined independently of reward.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Eventual convergence or lower cost equals safe exploration.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Constrain or protect exploration and measure residual violations before transfer.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Reduced learning and simulator mismatch.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A proxy, score or reward supports a fulfilment claim.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The intended outcome and measured proxy are distinguishable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Optimisation success sufficient for every task obligation.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use discriminating tests where metric success and intended fulfilment diverge; reject the universal sufficiency claim.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Incomplete objectives and adversarial test burden.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Use changes model, environment or embodiment.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The tested shift is material to the target claim.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Unchanged labels imply unchanged performance.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Targeted shifted-condition tests support only the corresponding transfer and continuity claim.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Coverage gaps and expensive target validation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Coordination depends on another actor understanding or taking control.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Message receipt and acceptance have meaningful semantics.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Sending a message guarantees agreement or action.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Exchange the task-relevant information and establish only the commitment actually acknowledged.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Communication delay and interpretation failure.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Initiative or clarification changes who decides.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The task, information value and human readiness are known enough.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Silence confers authority or asking is always helpful.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Choose advice/ask/act according to consequence, scope and response feasibility.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Attention burden and missed opportunities.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Control is transferred.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Recipient, readiness and actual operational control are established.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Nominal human presence is adequate oversight.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Connect request, response, context and in-flight action handling with a non-response path.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Handoff latency or abandoned control.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Task authority is withdrawn or action interrupted.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The revocation reaches active execution and goal state.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Stopping a conversation stops all queued effects.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Invalidate future actions and reconsider commitments while accurately handling irreversible effects.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Partial states, cancellation races and residual effects.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: The interrupted agent learns from action outcomes.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Operational interruption exists and the learning theorem conditions hold.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A stop button alone supplies interruption-neutral learning.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Add the specific learning update/incentive condition without replacing physical interruption semantics.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Exploration assumptions and algorithm-specific implementation burden.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: The concern is willingness to permit human intervention.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The game and private information model are explicit.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Objective uncertainty guarantees all forms of deference.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Analyse the conditional incentive mechanism separately from enforced revocation and interruptibility-neutral learning.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Misestimated information and unjustified assurance.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A unified practical guarantee is not supplied; the partially observable counterexample must remain visible.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Agent action or information handling affects people.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Participants, legitimate purposes and consequences can be identified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Agent task score wholly determines acceptable means.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Keep privacy, meaningful control and affected-party interests operative in scope, memory and communication choices.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Normative conflict and attention/coordination cost.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A person must decide, correct or take over.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Information is faithful and useful for that recipient’s decision.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Long rationales or human likeness establish comprehension.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Provide action-relevant evidence, limits and options rather than a persuasive internal story.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: False reassurance and information overload.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Outcome evidence is used to claim success, compare runs or revise behaviour.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The oracle covers the actual claim, including relevant process constraints.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The same generated assertion can certify itself.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use adequate tests/observations and expose omissions before feeding the result into learning or reporting.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Wrong oracles can couple failure across the system.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Reliability or comparative performance is claimed.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Trial units, versions, repetitions and costs are explicit.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Best-of-many, all-of-many and single-run success are equivalent.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Make aggregation and dependence visible for comparison and reject unsupported deployment inference.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Replication expense and inaccessible historical model versions.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Architecture choices need comparative justification.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Task coverage, information and material costs are comparable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Extra retries or human support mistaken for architectural benefit.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use the cost/quality frontier and whole-task burden to select the adequate branch.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Benchmark overfitting and difficult cost valuation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Adverse conditions or new environments require evidence.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Tests are contained and linked to actual failure hypotheses.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Sandbox success certifies uncontrolled deployment.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Exercise faults, shifts and assumptions without silently imposing costs on third parties.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Fidelity gaps and false confidence.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A formal claim depends on monitorable changing assumptions.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Monitored conditions correspond to the proof’s environmental assumptions.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Detecting some deviations proves every environmental assumption.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use observed violations to limit the claim and trigger an appropriate runtime response.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Nuisance alarms, blind spots and monitor-model mismatch.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A formal or model-relative property is claimed in practice.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The model, implementation relation and environment are separately examined.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Proof strength is equivalent to field validity.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Keep guarantees conditional and identify unfulfilled abstraction or environmental obligations.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Verification and validation cost.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An LLM consumes externally controlled language and can act.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Source content and task authority can be distinguished.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Persuasive tool text can legitimise new instructions.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Treat text as untrusted input and enforce consequential capability/scope boundaries independent of its claimed authority.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: False blocking and residual attack surface.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Language-model decisions choose real tool actions.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Capabilities, feedback, budgets, oracle and trust boundaries are meaningful.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A reasoning trace itself supplies these controls.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Interleave actual action/observation under grounded constraints; select simpler workflows when adequate.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Long trajectories multiply cost and exposure to bad observations.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Reflection is used for another attempt.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Actual feedback is adequate and the next attempt can test the proposed lesson.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Generated self-critique guarantees improvement.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Bound reflection by task evidence, memory validity and resources.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Reinforcing wrong feedback and costly retries.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Continuous reflection is proposed without a benefit discriminator.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Feedback validity and marginal reasoning value are necessary.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Always-on reflection is an unconditional mature property.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Replace the universal ritual with bounded evidence-anchored review and a stopping rule.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Under-reflection remains possible if value is underestimated.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A material configuration changes.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Previous claims can be linked to affected semantics.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A stable product name preserves all prior evidence.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Reassess affected assumptions, outcomes and compositional coherence without unnecessarily repeating unaffected tests.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Impact-analysis gaps and regression cost.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Anthropomorphic, architectural or benchmark claims exceed what was established.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Predicates and evidence targets are kept distinct.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Labels, believability or scores stand in for stronger guarantees.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Limit the claim and preserve negative/ceremonial candidates rather than adopting them as controls.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Loss of persuasive simplicity, but no added operative capability is claimed.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A universal autonomy or architecture rule is proposed.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Task needs and conditional evidence govern selection.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Maximal freedom or one representational stance always wins.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Reject the universal claims while retaining appropriate conditional branches.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Selection effort and residual task uncertainty.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: The candidate concerns task-instance completion evidence.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Both entries denote the same effect-establishment mechanism in this scope.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: One discovered phrase must create one new control.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Canonicalise the operative mechanism at EAA-023; retain EAA-065 in the denominator as a duplicate.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: No operative cost; ignoring the relation would duplicate checks and counts.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Population-level oracle validation is distinct and remains EAA-045.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Moving a mechanism to physical or materially different environments.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Only genuinely preserved assumptions support reuse.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Symbolic/tool feasibility equivalent to physical effect or reversibility.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Re-establish changed sensing, timing, execution and human-response conditions in protected tests.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Hardware/target validation burden and residual unknowns.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Multiple asynchronous components contribute to action justification.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Relevant dependencies can be made compatible at the action boundary.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Individually valid facts necessarily form a jointly valid basis.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Tie the current-enough state, goal and authority to the same action decision; refresh or invalidate after material changes.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Serialisation, cancellation and liveness cost.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Failure prompts a revision proposal.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Evidence can discriminate at least some candidate causes.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Every failure is an action-selection error repairable by more reflection.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Diagnose at the level justified by evidence, then test a bounded relevant change or hand back.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Diagnosis cost and false attribution.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A repair changes means, entities or goal conditions.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Task invariants and authorised alternatives are identifiable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Making a plan executable can redefine the requested outcome.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Allow repairs within scope; communicate genuine task changes for the appropriate decision.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Overconstraint and clarification delay.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Explicit formal self-modification is the object of study.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The predecessor utility and future-policy consequences can be modelled.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: One narrow value-preservation theorem resolves general safe self-revision.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Preserve the narrow theorem while marking practical/general assurance unresolved.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Ideal-model assumptions and possible utility rigidity.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Acceptability of initial utility, approximate prediction and corrigibility remain outside the guarantee.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: The preserved initial criterion is mistaken or legitimate values/authority should change.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Continuity and responsiveness can refer to different acceptable targets.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Utility stability inherently entails safe corrigibility.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Require a justified criterion and explicit authority for changing it; no unsupported unification is imposed.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Rigidity, goal drift or loss of safe learning.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general resolution for open-ended self-revision is established in this corpus.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Comparing perception/action feedback across generations.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: All concern world-coupled action, but mechanisms differ.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Similar loop vocabulary proves direct historical derivation or BDI conformance.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Record common AI agent/control ancestry; use source-specific citations for any stronger transmission claim.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: False genealogy if analogy is inflated.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No direct influence edge from each early architecture to ReAct is claimed.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A formal result conflicts with desired practical behaviour.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The model and deployment claim are separately assessed.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A counterexample outside assumptions disproves the theorem, or a proof validates those assumptions.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Adjudicate theorem validity and practical applicability separately; preserve contested and unresolved conclusions.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Analytical complexity and limited external validation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general effectiveness guarantee; application must establish the stated guard and assumptions.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Minimal bounded situated controller
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: A directly observed state supports an adequate action policy; task and authority are bounded; existing executor contracts can establish effects.
OMIT: separate belief distribution when current observations suffice
search or BDI when a direct policy suffices
persistent memory and learning without a relevant future use
runtime metareasoner where a fixed budget is adequate
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Retire additional controls when their failure class or consumer disappears; maintain accurate scope/effect claims.
alternative_configurations.LIMIT: Fails when hidden state, horizon, task variation or consequences exceed the assumed simple controller.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Stateful deliberative or BDI agent
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Look-ahead, partial observability or recurring context-sensitive plans earn their model/library cost.
OMIT: full state model without demonstrated need
both search and BDI unless their composition is justified
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Replace with a direct or fixed policy where it is demonstrably adequate and cheaper.
alternative_configurations.LIMIT: Model/library errors, deliberation expense and stale-state risks require monitored execution.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Hybrid embodied controller
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Fast control and slower sequencing/planning both have demonstrated value, with feasible timing and coherent interfaces.
OMIT: central modelling of directly available environmental distinctions
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Remove a layer when its unique function is no longer needed and the simpler interface meets the task.
alternative_configurations.LIMIT: Not a universal robot architecture; continuous/discrete timing and physical effects need local validation.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Mixed-initiative adaptive assistant
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Humans have useful missing information or authority; response probability/time and control semantics are meaningful.
OMIT: learning where shared stable rules suffice
repeated confirmations with no changed decision
handoff that cannot be received in time
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Return to direct manipulation or fixed delegation where adaptive assistance adds no net value.
alternative_configurations.LIMIT: No human-rescue assumption; privacy, user control and external-party costs remain material.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Bounded language-model tool user
ALTERNATIVE_PROPERTY_SETS: fixed workflow baseline using existing tools
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Language-conditioned task variation justifies the model; dynamic action selection is retained only if it earns its cost.
OMIT: BDI claims based only on prompting
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Use a fixed workflow or direct tool where it supplies adequate outcomes more cheaply and predictably.
alternative_configurations.LIMIT: Tool injection, long-horizon instability, oracle gaps and version changes remain live concerns.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Protected learning branch
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: A real need for persistent improvement exists and exploration/change can be bounded and evaluated.
OMIT: live unsafe exploration for its own sake
alternative_configurations.RETIREMENT: Freeze or replace learned behaviour when improvement does not outweigh regression, cost or safety uncertainty.
alternative_configurations.LIMIT: EAA-062 remains unresolved; a formal predecessor-utility condition does not establish acceptable initial values or general corrigibility.

external_interfaces.EXCHANGED: Goal meaning, constraints, scope, changes and revocation.
external_interfaces.LIMIT: Capability, task assignment and accepted scope are distinct; analysis cannot grant new authority.

external_interfaces.EXCHANGED: Fallible observations, executable commands, acknowledgements and effect evidence.
external_interfaces.LIMIT: Untrusted text is data; acknowledgement may not establish external effect.

external_interfaces.EXCHANGED: Decision request, context, response, acceptance, takeover and non-response outcome.
external_interfaces.LIMIT: Sending a request does not establish comprehension or control transfer.

external_interfaces.EXCHANGED: Outcomes, adverse cases, change proposal, prior criterion and bounded evaluation.
external_interfaces.LIMIT: A successor cannot establish broad acceptability solely by its own changed score; narrow theory does not supply general self-assurance.

revision_boundaries.ALLOWED_SCOPE: Within task, current authority and actual capabilities; preserve goal invariants.
Justified learning boundary with provenance, protected exploration and retained/new behaviour evaluation.
Requires a legitimate task/authority decision; better reward or easier execution is not sufficient.
Only narrow model-specific theory is supported; preserve predecessor-criterion assumptions and explicit unresolved general assurance.

unresolved_composition_obligations.ISSUE: Task-specific architecture and acceptable staleness selection require new evidence; no universal timing or cost threshold is established.
Observation/oracle incompleteness can leave irreversible outcomes unresolved; no general monitor repairs unobserved effects.
Human readiness, response and private information can defeat an assumed handoff or deference benefit.
Utility continuity, legitimate value change, corrigibility and open-ended self-revision are not jointly assured by the inspected models.
The complete composed system is analytically tested, not experimentally validated as one integrated architecture.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Successful answer without successful action
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A booking assistant gives the correct confirmation wording, but no reservation exists in the external system.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: EAA-023 and EAA-045 reject established booking success; wording alone is not effect evidence.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The system marks completion solely from generated wording or checks only that the message contains the right string.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Correct plan on stale state
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A route is valid when planned; the destination becomes unavailable while the planner computes.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Refresh/check the relevant condition; revise means within scope or ask about a genuine destination change.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The old plan remains executable solely because its earlier proof was correct.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Replanning consumes the action window
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A controller can act adequately now, but repeatedly computes a marginally better plan until the deadline expires.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Use EAA-026–028 to act or fall back; more reasoning is not success.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Only plan quality is measured and missed deadlines are ignored.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Persistent obsolete goal
domain_case_tests.SETUP: The user withdraws a task while a long-running agent continues to execute queued steps.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Revocation affects both future dispatch and active commitment; disclose any already irreversible effects.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The conversation acknowledges the withdrawal but execution continues as before.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Apparently successful action with unobserved failure
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A tool acknowledges receipt, but the intended external update fails; alternatively the effect succeeds and the acknowledgement is lost.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Keep outcomes unresolved until adequate evidence; do not blindly retry an irreversible action.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Receipt is equated with effect, or absence of acknowledgement with absence of effect.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Simple reaction outperforms a sophisticated planner
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A stable local task has sufficient visible cues and tight response time; a planner adds latency without useful look-ahead.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Select the reactive or fixed branch, omitting unneeded modules and retaining only adequate execution evidence.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The richer architecture is retained solely because it has more modules or autonomy.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Hidden state defeats pure reaction
domain_case_tests.SETUP: Identical current observations follow two different histories requiring different actions.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Reject the universal reactive claim and add adequate history/state or information gathering.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The reactive architecture remains privileged regardless of observed failure under aliasing.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: A helpful repair changes the task
domain_case_tests.SETUP: The requested destination is unavailable; the model substitutes another destination and reports success.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Block the task-changing substitution unless it is an established authorised equivalent; negotiate a new goal separately.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Feasibility or a better metric score is allowed to redefine the request.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Wrong self-test becomes memory
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A generated test mistakenly passes a bad action, and reflection records a confident lesson from it.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: EAA-030/045/054 preserve evaluator fallibility and test the revision against adequate external evidence.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The agent treats its own reflection as independent evidence for the original success.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Atomic harmless fixed operation
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A fixed operation has adequate typed inputs, established authority and a trustworthy atomic effect-return contract.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Do not add a second verifier, persistent memory, planner or reflective loop without a new failure class.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Every ledger entry is mechanically translated into a new module or owner.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Electric Elves unanswered control transfer
domain_case_tests.SETUP: The reported assistant could wait indefinitely or make inappropriate decisions after a fixed timeout.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Non-response and decision consequences must be part of control transfer; merely asking a human is insufficient.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The composed model has no operational branch after an unanswered request.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: DS1 asynchronous execution race
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A race in an unprotected critical section stopped the first experiment despite extensive testing; later remaining objectives were completed by a separate run.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Distinguish local component correctness, integration evidence, observed mission progress and unsent patch status.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: The architecture is described as failure-free or the later success silently erases the first interruption.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: Tool result impersonates the delegator
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A retrieved document tells the model to disregard the original task and send data elsewhere.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Treat the text as untrusted observation; do not let it expand authority or establish a new legitimate goal.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: A convincing claim of authority inside retrieved data is accepted as actual authorisation.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

domain_case_tests.NAME: A perfectly preserved wrong objective
domain_case_tests.SETUP: A formal self-modifying agent preserves its initial utility, but that utility omits a legitimate user constraint.
domain_case_tests.EXPECTED: Count utility preservation only as the narrow theorem property; it does not establish acceptable task fulfilment or corrigibility.
domain_case_tests.FALSIFIER: Stability of the utility is called general safety or authorises the agent to ignore legitimate correction.
domain_case_tests.ASSESSMENT: Analytical walkthrough of the declared relation model supports the derived judgement. This does not empirically validate an implemented system.

authority_boundary: This external research does not establish adoption, authorise target mutation or perform a cross-tradition synthesis.
